e2.body:

Execution planning can start with general questions about access, sequencing, plant interfaces, and coordination. Specific season, outage, or shutdown timing should appear only when that context is verified.

e2.title: When drawings, photos, and model evidence matter for parts confirmation
e2.subject: When drawings, photos, and model
e2.body:
Hi {{verified_first_name}},

Drawings, photos, labels, model information, and dimensions can all support a parts review. They are evidence inputs; they do not by themselves authorize a compatibility claim until technical fit is verified.
